method: side-by-side inspection of the exact pinned current image bytes; historical prompts and source read separately

source_evidence.quote: 船頭上插青龍牙旗，船尾各繫走舸。
黃蓋在第三隻火船上，獨披掩心甲，手提利刃
是時東風大作，波浪洶湧。
黃蓋用刀一招，前船一齊發火。

shared_world_state.must_match: same approaching fireboat fleet and flag hue across departure and Cao reverse view
shared_world_state.future_canonical_rendering: blue-green / 青色 flags; a source-grounded production choice, not a measured historical RGB
shared_world_state.shape: not fixed by this gate; do not invent exact flag geometry or new lettering
allowed_changes: unlit → ignited → fire spreads after explicit ignition event

shared_world_state.must_match: Huang Gai knows the fire plan; Cao initially believes surrender; panorama sailors remain unnamed
allowed_changes: Cao may become alarmed only after suspicion/attack in source
different_objects_not_to_equate: Huang Gai is not Cao Cao
foreground anonymous sailors are not automatically named leaders

shots.source_instant: Huang Gai departs on third fireboat, before ignition
shots.actual_observation: Rust/red pennants on fireboats, dusk sky, straw and oil jars, unlit ships; Huang Gai commands with lowered blade.

shots.source_instant: Cao watches approaching boats before ignition
shots.actual_observation: Incoming boat pennants are blue-green; moonlit rough river; Cao stands confidently, adviser concerned; no ship fire.

shots.source_instant: After ignition, burning fireboats reach linked fleet and shore camp
shots.actual_observation: Foreground-left attacking boat pennant appears red; fire spreads through large ships toward shore; anonymous foreground boatmen. Warm sky glow remains.

pair_checks.observation: Same attacking fleet changes from red to blue-green before ignition.
pair_checks.cause_or_evidence: No source event authorizes a flag swap. Original departure prompt leaves flag hue open; watch prompt explicitly asks blue-green.
pair_checks.next_action: For a future edit attach shared flag swatch/boat reference, retain old requests and inspect both outputs again.

pair_checks.observation: Blue-green incoming flags become red-looking on attacking boat in the fire panorama.
pair_checks.cause_or_evidence: Warm firelight may shift appearance; no proof it alone explains the hue. Do not claim a clean match.
pair_checks.next_action: Review under a shared palette in any future correction, without promising current pixels already match.

pair_checks.observation: Distinct opposing decks, fleet departure then approach; dusk then moonlit river.
pair_checks.cause_or_evidence: Camera/temporal change follows departure and later moonlit approach; no exact bank geometry claimed.

pair_checks.observation: Unlit incoming boats become burning boats and linked fleet/shore fire.
pair_checks.cause_or_evidence: Source contains an explicit ignition event; fire must not appear in earlier unlit shots.
pair_checks.next_action: Keep source instant and before/after ignition state on each new shot.

pair_checks.observation: Moonlit watch view becomes a panorama with warm horizon glow.
pair_checks.cause_or_evidence: Fire can warm light but panorama may read as dusk; not an exact time reconstruction.
pair_checks.next_action: Future grade should retain night cues; do not reorder source events to fit the sky.

legacy_review_scope: The 2026-11-12 per-image assistant checks remain historical. Their passed state is not a pass of this supplemental paired-shot gate.
resolution: Unresolved. Shared hue is proposed for future correction, NOT corrected output. No historical prompt rewrite, clean-flag claim, regenerated image, or creator promotion.
